title: PUREX
description: The &3PUREX&r is a machine that can reprocess depleted nuclear fuel into various materials. Most recipes require both &bNitric Acid&r and &bKerosene&r to function.
&6Schrabidium&r can also be extracted from certain recipes, which require &bSchrabidic Acid&r. The schrabidium extracted yields double the schrabidium used to make the acid.
